{{Current events|year=2026|month=03|day=5|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
***[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian Foreign Minister]] [[Abbas Araghchi]] says that [[Iran]] is not seeking a ceasefire or negotiations with the [[United States]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/05/iran-us-war-invasion-abbas-araghchi.html (CNBC)]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Akrotiri and Dhekelia]]
***[[Spain]] announces that the [[frigate]] [[Spanish frigate Cristóbal Colón|''Cristóbal Colón'']] will join [[France|French]] [[aircraft carrier]] [[French aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle|''Charles de Gaulle'']] and [[Greek Navy]] ships to protect the [[Sovereign Base Areas of Akrotiri and Dhekelia|British military bases]] in [[Cyprus]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/spain-to-send-frigate-to-cyprus-after-drone-strike (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
***[[Italy]] announces that it will dispatch [[Italian Navy|naval]] assets to Cyprus. The [[Royal Netherlands Navy|Dutch navy]] is also joining the European naval task force. [https://www.euronews.com/2026/03/05/spain-italy-and-netherlands-join-european-naval-deployment-to-cyprus (Euronews)]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Azerbaijan]] 
***Suspected Iranian drones strike [[Nakhchivan International Airport]] in [[Azerbaijan]], targeting the [[airport terminal|passenger terminal]]. At least two people are injured. [https://www.euronews.com/2026/03/05/iranian-drones-strike-azerbaijans-razi-airport-in-nakhchivan (Euronews)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/missiles-drones-coming-iran-fell-airport-azerbaijan-source-says-2026-03-05/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c62gg44d53xt (BBC News)]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Bahrain]]
***The [[Bahrain]]i [[Bahrain Defence Force|military]] reports that 74 Iranian missiles and 117 hostile drones have been intercepted and destroyed. A missile hit an oil refinery, causing a fire. [https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/bahrain-defence-force-74-iranian-missiles117-hostile-drones-destroyed-1.500463658 (WAM via ''Gulf News'')], [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/5/drone-targets-us-base-in-iraq-as-iran-attacks-hit-region-amid-us-israel-war (Al Jazeera)]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Qatar]]
***The Qatari military says that the country was targeted today by 14 ballistic missiles and four drones coming from Iran; all of them were intercepted and no casualties were reported. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/5/drone-targets-us-base-in-iraq-as-iran-attacks-hit-region-amid-us-israel-war (Al Jazeera)]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on the United Arab Emirates]]
***The [[United Arab Emirates]]'s [[Anti-aircraft warfare|air defence systems]] intercept six [[Ballistic missile program of Iran|ballistic missile]]s and 125 [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drones]] launched by [[Iran]].  Six people were injured by falling debris over Abu Dhabi. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/5/drone-targets-us-base-in-iraq-as-iran-attacks-hit-region-amid-us-israel-war (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/03/05/live-israel-us-iran-missiles-uae/ (''The National News'')]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Iraq]]
***Iraqi forces shoot down a drone that attempted to attack the United States  Victoria airbase near Baghdad. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/5/drone-targets-us-base-in-iraq-as-iran-attacks-hit-region-amid-us-israel-war (Al Jazeera)]
**[[2026 Kurdish rebellion in Iran]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] says [[United States Air Force|U.S. Air Force]] jets will provide "extensive air cover" for [[Kurds in Iran|Kurdish]] forces in any ground offensive against the [[Government of Iran|Iranian government]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2026/03/05/iran-latest-news-trump-israel-us-war-netanyahu/ (''The Telegraph'')]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***It is reported that [[China]] is in talks with Iran to allow crude oil and Qatari liquefied natural gas vessels safe passage through the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/china-talks-with-iran-allow-safe-oil-gas-passage-through-hormuz-sources-say-2026-03-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
**[[2026 Hezbollah–Israel strikes]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] issues an [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] order for [[Dahieh]], [[Beirut]], a densely populated suburb which is also a stronghold of [[Hezbollah]], telling residents to "save your lives and evacuate your homes immediately". Thousands of people flee following the warning. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-issues-unprecedented-evacuation-warning-for-entire-hezbollah-stronghold-in-beirut/ (''The Times of Israel''')] [https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2026-03-05/thousands-flee-beirut-suburbs-after-unprecedented-israeli-evacuation-order (''The Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**The [[Ukrainian Navy]] shoots down a [[Russian Naval Aviation]] [[Kamov Ka-27]] helicopter over the [[Black Sea]]. The number of casualties is unknown. [https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/ukrainian-navy-destroys-russian-ka-27-helicopter-1772716052.html (RBC-Ukraine)] [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/567623 (ASN)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Lee Jae Myung]] orders the activation of a [[South Korean won|₩]]100 trillion (about [[United States dollar|US$]]68 billion) [[stabilization fund]] to address [[Volatility (finance)|volatility]] in [[Economy of South Korea|the country's financial markets]] linked to the [[2026 Iran war|Iran war]]. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/us-stocks/news/global-markets-south-korea-activates-68-bn-market-stability-fund-over-mideast-crisis/articleshow/129065643.cms (AFP via ''The Economic Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least six people are killed, eight others are rescued, and six are trapped when a [[nursing home]] collapses in [[Belo Horizonte]], [[Minas Gerais]], [[Brazil]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260306/27289fffb62c47708007d94f489426b1/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Two people are killed and four others are injured when a [[Beechcraft 1900]] of the [[Algerian Air Force]] crashes at [[Boufarik Airport]] near [[Boufarik]], [[Blida Province]], [[Algeria]]. [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/567625 (ASN)]
*The [[United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations]] reports that an explosion struck a [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]] anchored in waters about 60 kilometers off the coast of [[Kuwait]], causing an [[oil spill]] from a damaged cargo tank. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/uk-maritime-agency-reports-explosion-oil-spill-off-kuwait/MIWZUT7Z6RHS5NG5HRUMVN7XLE/ (AFP via ''The New Zealand Herald'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–Lebanon relations]]
**The [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] [[Cabinet of Nawaf Salam|cabinet]] prohibits activities by members of Iran's [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] within Lebanon and instructs authorities to detain and deport individuals linked to the group. The cabinet also introduces a [[Visa policy of Lebanon|visa requirement]] for [[Iranian nationality law|Iranian nationals]] entering the country. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/563456.aspx (AFP via ''Al-Ahram'')]
*[[Foreign relations of Ecuador]]
**[[Ecuador]] declares [[Cuba]]'s ambassador to the country a ''[[persona non grata]]'' and orders him and all his diplomatic staff to leave the country within 48 hours. Shortly after the announcement, a man was filmed by the ''[[Associated Press]]'' on the roof of the [[List of diplomatic missions of Cuba|Cuban embassy]] in [[Quito]] burning a bag of papers. [https://apnews.com/article/ecuador-cuba-trump-noboa-bc7b4bab79e54a39bb8f18d683105b22 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Kosovan presidential election]]
**In [[Kosovo]], the 120 members of the [[Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo|Kuvendi]] fail to [[indirect election|elect]] the [[President of Kosovo|president]]. The Kuvendi is expected to dissolve, with [[Elections in Kosovo|parliamentary elections]] scheduled to be set within 45 days. [https://dtt-net.com/kosovo-goes-early-elections-again-as-election-of-president-fails/ (''DTT-NET'')] [https://rks.news/no-quorum-to-continue-presidential-vote-in-kosovo-parliament/ (''RKS'')]
*[[2026 Nepalese general election]]
**[[Nepalis]] vote to elect 275 seats of the [[House of Representatives (Nepal)|House of Representatives]] nearly six months after the [[2025 Nepalese Gen Z protests|Gen Z protests]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nepal-shah-oli-protests-election-58cac72e25490c8c6363626a7dc10171 (AP)]
*[[Second cabinet of Donald Trump]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] fires [[Kristi Noem]] as [[United States Secretary of Homeland Security|Secretary of Homeland Security]] and nominates [[List of United States senators from Oklahoma|Oklahoma Senator]] [[Markwayne Mullin]] to replace her. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/kristi-noem-fired-homeland-security-secretary-trump-b2932900.html (''The Independent'')]
